In 4-dimensional [[geometry]], the '''cubical bipyramid''' is the [[direct sum]] of a cube and a segment, {4,3} + { }. Each face of a central [[cube]] is attached with two [[square pyramid]]s, creating 12 square pyramidal cells, 30 triangular faces, 28 edges, and 10 vertices. A cubical bipyramid can be seen as two [[cubic pyramid]]s augmented together at their base.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://bendwavy.org/klitzing/incmats/cubdipy.htm | title=Cute }}</ref>

It is the dual of a [[octahedral prism]]. 

Being convex and regular-faced, it is a [[CRF polytope]].

== Coordinates==
It is a [[Hanner polytope]] with coordinates:<ref>{{cite web | url=https://bendwavy.org/klitzing/explain/hanner.htm | title=Hanner polytopes }}</ref>
* [2] (0, 0, 0; ±1)
* [8] (±1, ±1, ±1; 0)
